style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. Early 7th-century Arabia and Yemen. Any people are small, distant, seen from behind, ordinary travellers in simple earth-toned robes and head wraps.

scenes.s1: Dawn outside an ancient walled oasis town of palm groves and mud-brick houses; a long caravan of camels and travellers arriving from the south along a dusty road, golden low sun, dust in the air, everyone tiny and seen from behind.
scenes.s2: Inside a humble mud-brick room at night: a woven palm mat, a clay water jug, a small bowl of milk and a piece of bread on a tray beside a neatly made sleeping mat, lit by one small oil lamp. Warm, quiet, no people.
scenes.s3: Terraced green mountain fields and small stone houses of an old Yemeni highland village at sunrise, mist in the valleys, soft warm light. No people close.
scenes.s4: A wide camp of travellers resting outside an ancient oasis town: tents, camels kneeling, cooking smoke, banners, late afternoon light; small figures from behind.
scenes.s5: A single lit window in a small stone house under a vast starry night sky in the desert hills, warm lamplight inside, peaceful. No people visible.
scenes.s6: An old dusty desert road stretching toward far mountains, a line of tiny travellers walking away from the camera, evening light, long shadows.
scenes.s7: The entrance of a simple tent at dusk with warm lamplight glowing from inside, the cloth flap half open, a pair of worn sandals outside. No people visible.
scenes.s8: Golden rays of light breaking through clouds over palm groves and a quiet ancient oasis town, birds in the sky, hopeful and bright.
scenes.s9: A modern-timeless warm home doorway: a tray with a glass of water and a few dates set down beside a closed wooden door, soft morning light. No people visible.
